**ROUND 1: "THE OPENING BELL" - STADIUM**

*The crowd goes silent as our heavyweight champion enters the ring...*

**The Combo:**
First priority is securing  [Primal Punch](item_3b024d32-8fa1-4713-80ee-e042867f5228) Power (because regular monkey slaps are for chumps), the +2 damage per 25 armor on melee (turning armored enemies into your personal heavy bags), and Jump Pack reset on elimination (because what's scarier than an angry gorilla? A *flying* angry gorilla with unlimited mobility).

While other Winstons are out here playing patty-cake with their enemies, you're collecting these upgrades like Infinity Stones.  You're not just a tank anymore - you're a rocket-powered heavyweight champion with a grudge against anyone foolish enough to show their face on the battlefield.

*The other team just walked into a boxing match with pool noodles while you're wearing brass knuckles made of pure optimization.*

**Round 1: FIGHT!** 🥊

**ROUND 2: "THE KNOCKOUT PUNCH" - STADIUM**

*The bell rings and our champion is ready to evolve from heavyweight boxer to flying death machine...*

**The Evolution:**
We're adding  [Moon Landing](item_cc4f210b-31e1-47b2-8400-325afcc4892b)  Landing to the arsenal - now you heal 7% HP per enemy hit with Jump Pack. You're literally a vampire gorilla, sustaining yourself by landing on people's faces. Who needs health packs when you can just belly flop onto the enemy team?

**The Big Investment:**
Time to empty the bank account for the good stuff.  [Lucheng Launchers](item_b246324c-7cdb-476c-8d3f-370fad8656e0)  give us 50% longer Primal Rage (more monkey time = more problems for enemies) plus 50% Jump Pack base damage that turns ELECTRIC during rage and can ramp up to 200% damage while airborne. You're literally a flying lightning gorilla now.

 [Zero-G Suit](item_404d695a-1c12-47ac-9bc4-00b6e6e985e6)  lets us close distance like a heat-seeking missile - 50% movement speed boost for 2 seconds after any jump, plus permanent 5% speed boost.

**The Result:**
You're a self-healing, electric-powered, speed-boosted gorilla missile. Jump into groups, heal off their suffering, chase down survivors at warp speed, punch them into next week, get the reset, repeat.

*Other Winstons are playing checkers while you're playing 4D chess with your knuckles.*

**Round 2: PURE DOMINATION!** ⚡🦍

**ROUND 3: "THE FLYING GUILLOTINE" - STADIUM**

*The champion enters the final round, and physics itself starts sweating...*

**The New Power: **
Now we're cooking with gas.  [Primal Slam](item_9c54910d-33eb-4b3c-b04c-c9ac9b6f533a)  lets you press jump during Jump Pack to slam toward whatever you're looking at - it's like having a built-in "delete enemy" button with directional targeting. During Primal Rage, this thing moves 50% faster because apparently we needed to make the flying gorilla *more* terrifying.

**The Investment: **
We're grabbing  [Horizon Expander](item_802be403-6ba0-42ed-8f43-c106efefd5b7)  for 20% ability power, boosting Jump Pack base damage by 20% and cranking the landing area up to 100% bigger while airborne. You're no longer just landing on enemies - you're carpet bombing entire zip codes with gorilla justice.

**The Complete Picture:**
You're now a self-healing  [Moon Landing](item_cc4f210b-31e1-47b2-8400-325afcc4892b) , speed-boosted  [Zero-G Suit](item_404d695a-1c12-47ac-9bc4-00b6e6e985e6) , electrically-charged  [Lucheng Launchers](item_b246324c-7cdb-476c-8d3f-370fad8656e0) , area-of-effect nightmare with pinpoint slam accuracy and expanded blast radius. Jump, heal off enemy faces, slam toward specific targets, electrocute everything in a massive area, get resets, repeat until the enemy team uninstalls.

*Other Winstons are playing hopscotch while you're conducting orbital strikes with your body.*

**Round 3: TOTAL ANNIHILATION!** 💥⚡🦍

**ROUND 4: "THE UNTOUCHABLE CHAMPION" - STADIUM**

*The final bell rings, and even the Overwatch gods are placing bets on the outcome...*

**The Fortress Upgrade: Fortified Jump Pack**
Time to become literally untouchable. Fortified Jump Pack grants 35% damage reduction during Jump Pack AND throws in 50 bonus armor just because we deserve nice things. You're no longer just a flying gorilla - you're a flying *armored* gorilla with built-in plot armor.

**The Complete Monstrosity:**
Let's recap what we've created here. You're a self-healing (Moon Landing), speed-boosted (Zero G Suit), electrically-charged (Lucheng Launchers), area-of-effect monster (Horizon Expander) with pinpoint slam accuracy (Primal Slam), elimination resets, and now you're virtually invincible while flying through the air.

You jump in, take 35% less damage while airborne, heal off everyone's pain, slam specific targets with laser precision, electrocute entire neighborhoods, chase down survivors at light speed, and get resets to do it all over again - all while being tankier than a literal tank.

*The enemy team isn't playing Overwatch anymore - they're playing "Please Make It Stop: The Game."*

**Round 4: CHAMPIONSHIP SECURED!** 🏆💥⚡🦍

*Ding ding ding! We have a winner!*

**ROUND 5: "THE UNDISPUTED GALACTIC CHAMPION" - STADIUM**

*At this point, the crowd has stopped cheering and started praying...*

**The Ultimate Evolution: Lunar Leap**
Lunar Leap is the cherry on top of our destruction sundae - 2% ultimate charge per enemy hit by Jump Pack (because apparently we needed our ultimate up every 30 seconds) PLUS 5% overheal every second while using Jump Pack. You're not just healing off enemy tears anymore, you're literally growing stronger mid-flight.

**The Strategic Choice: Cybervenom**
We're going with Cybervenom because why just kill enemies when you can make sure they stay dead? 10% ability power boosts our Jump Pack damage even further, and the 30% healing reduction for 2 seconds means enemy supports can't undo our beautiful artwork. It's like putting a "No Healing" sign on everyone you land on.

**Optional Upgrades for the Financially Blessed:**
- **Martian Mender**: 3% health regen per second for the lazy approach to immortality
- **Crusader Hydraulics**: 10% damage reduction while armored + 25 bonus armor for the paranoid
- **Superflexor**: 10% weapon power + 5% ability power per Tesla Cannon hit (stacks to 5, so instant 25% ability power buff) - because your electric punches needed to hurt even MORE

**The Final Form:**
You are now an overheal-generating, ultimate-farming, healing-denying, damage-reducing, speed-boosting, armor-stacked, electrically-charged, area-bombing, target-slamming, self-healing gorilla of mass destruction with infinite resets and optional god-mode accessories.

*Other Winston builds are like bringing a butter knife to a nuclear war.*

**ROUND 5: GODLIKE STATUS ACHIEVED!** 👑💥⚡🦍
